notes.title: Small patch to update input controls
notes.notes:
This patch makes the following changes:
- Added setting for brightness
- Added setting for invert Y
- Added setting for mouse sensitivity
- The E key is now used for both grabbing objects and interact. G key is no longer used

notes.title: Patch 1.1 released!
notes.notes:
Features and bug fixes included:
[list]
[*] 2x frame rate boost optimizations for levels 1-5 (mainly HLOD instancing)
[*] Disabled motion blur and manual instead of auto exposure for better look
[*] More clear options menu
[*] Added discord community link to main menu screen
[*] Added waypoints and hints to make it easier to play the first few levels
[/list]
